summary: @servicetitan/form-state preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs fetches a Bun runtime release from github.com/oven-sh/bun for the current platform/arch, unpacks it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it to run the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated blob (numeric string-array + code-point decoder, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) that is not referenced from the package's advertised entry point (dist/index.js, a small mobx/form-state utility library). Pulling a second language runtime solely to execute an obfuscated sibling script under it evades tooling that only inspects Node-reachable code and has no relation to the declared purpose of a React/mobx form-state helper. The delivery channel — preinstall → download alternate runtime → execute obfuscated payload — runs on every `npm install` of this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
